Add dynamic resource allocation: route to specialized “customization pool” based on real-time capacity and predicted effort.

Long-term complexity decreases because volumes are smoother, exceptions are predicted, and manual touchpoints drop significantly. Monitor via process mining on event logs to continuously retrain the predictive models.
